terrain.method: South polar stereographic, 240 m grid resampled to 1025 x 1025 nodes (380.9 m) with a triangular filter. Heights in metres above the 1737.4 km sphere.

ephemeris.product: NASA/JPL Horizons On-Line Ephemeris System, DE441 (J. D. Giorgini and the JPL Solar System Dynamics Group)
ephemeris.method: Sub-solar and sub-Earth points in the Moon-fixed MOON_ME frame, light-time corrected, every 3 h.

sites.product: NASA GSFC PGDA, High-Resolution LOLA Topography for Lunar South Pole Sites (Barker et al. 2021)
